parts.refutation: Three checks have passes false: watchdog stall cover (V2), watchdog window (V1 and V2) and image watchdog timeout (V4). Each fails on firmware as it stands in checkout fe53d3a8bc9a, not on a datasheet value: the RP2350 watchdog takes any timeout up to 0xffffff us (about 16 s, Table 1249), but V2's stall is 900 ms with a stalled host and unbounded with a slow host, V1 allows 500 ms, and firmware/iomcu/ calls no watchdog function (grep finds only the comment at main.c:970-973; no watchdog call anywhere under firmware/ or shared/). RP2354B is a fixed input of the Scope table: reported to the owner, not re-selected, as FU-A4's and FU-2A's adjudicators ruled. The other 25 checks pass. The time from watchdog expiry to the pads at their reset state is not stated in the datasheet (not measured).
